name: ai-capability-evaluator
title: AI 候选人能力评审
job_to_be_done: Grade each candidate's submitted AI work from Assisted to L4 using images, PDFs, HTML or Git, and create a separate viewable HTML page per person. Use for 候选人 AI 能力评级、候选人材料评审、一人一页 HR 报告. Excludes resume formatting, personality assessment, hiring decisions and project creation.

trigger_surface.description: Grade each candidate's submitted AI work from Assisted to L4 using images, PDFs, HTML or Git, and create a separate viewable HTML page per person. Use for 候选人 AI 能力评级、候选人材料评审、一人一页 HR 报告. Excludes resume formatting, personality assessment, hiring decisions and project creation.
should_trigger: 请对候选人 AI 项目材料做等级评价，不需要审核。
根据这份 PDF 给候选人的 AI 能力评级，输出 HR HTML 报告。
Evaluate this candidate's submitted AI work using the five-level rubric.
候选人提交 Git 仓库和截图，做 AI 能力评审。
给每位候选人 AI 能力定级，做成一人一页的 HTML。
should_not_trigger: 帮我写一个 AI 自动化项目。
把这份 PDF 转成 Word，不需要评价候选人。
edge_cases: 只帮我美化简历排版，不要能力评级。
根据学校和年龄排列候选人录用顺序。
审查代码是否有 SQL 注入漏洞。

steps: Inspect one candidate's sources and freeze a grade-free evidence packet.
Launch a NEW no-history scorer with rubric 1.1, packet, allowed originals and contract 2.0.
Assign a nonnull level; use explicitly provisional Assisted only if no substantiated level is possible.
Validate schema, render a distinct two-section HTML page, open on right and update the directory index.
Complete the current person before processing the next. No independent audit.
decision_points: Supported vs provisional placement and evidence confidence

eval_plan.baseline: missing evidence: no measured no-skill baseline yet
